comment: EuGate - Euclidean rhythm gate that chops the sound into a repeating pattern in time with your tempo, for synths, vocals, samples and drum machines. Steps = pattern length (1 to 64 sixteenths, so odd lengths make polymeters); Notes = how many notes play, spread evenly (Euclidean) over the steps; Shift moves the pattern; Swing delays only the weak 16ths; Reset restarts the pattern at every new note or when the pedal is turned on; Gap = small silence between two notes that touch; Soft = how soft the edges are; Tempo is the BPM; Mix is dry/wet.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 480 DualShft, 485 DubSiren, 486 Choral, 487 WaveFold, 488 EuGate (this pack). Unique inside the repo; check other community effects.

params.name: Notes
params.comment: How many notes play out of the steps, spread as evenly as possible. Shows 1 to 64. At or above the number of steps every step plays. Default 5.

params.name: Steps
params.comment: Pattern length in 16th-note steps, shows 1 to 64. The pattern repeats after this many steps, so any length other than 16 (or 32, 64) runs against the bar: polymeters. Default 16.

params.name: Shift
params.comment: Starts the pattern later by this many steps (0 to 63; it wraps around, so with 1 bar 16 is the same as 0).

params.name: Swing
params.comment: Shuffle. Delays only the weak 16ths (the 2nd and 4th 16th of each beat). 0 = straight, 100 = very shuffled.

params.name: Reset
params.comment: What restarts the pattern at step 1. OFF = nothing, the pattern keeps running. NOTE = each time a note starts after a moment of silence. PEDAL = when you turn the effect on with the footswitch. SYNC = the setting for bar sync from a host: same as OFF, only the Tempo twin flips restart the pattern. Default OFF.

params.name: Gap
params.comment: Small silence between two notes that touch. When a note is directly followed by another note, the sound is turned off for the last part of the first one, so you hear two notes. Shown as a percent of one step, so it scales with the tempo: 0 = no gap (touching notes join), 50 = half a step. Notes with a rest after them are not changed. When every step is a note, it chops each step. Default 15.

params.name: Soft
params.comment: How soft the start and end of each note are. 0 = sharp chop, 100 = smooth swell. Scales with the tempo. Default 35.

params.name: Tempo
params.comment: Speed in BPM (40 to 240), shown on screen. Every step is a 16th note, so 120 = 125 ms per step. Flipping to the twin copy of the same BPM (120 <-> 321) restarts the pattern at step 1 without changing the tempo, whatever Reset says: a host can send that on each downbeat. A plain tempo change does not restart it. SYNC RESET: the knob runs 0..441 and holds every BPM twice: 241..441 is a twin copy (BPM = screen - 201, so past 240 the screen shows 40 again; both copies show the BPM). Default 120. FOLLW (0..39, the bottom of the knob): the BPM comes from the bar sync sent by an effect in an earlier slot (120 without one). On any setting, bars sent from an earlier slot restart it like a flip of its own Tempo.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Dry/wet crossfade, DJ style: dry full up to 50, wet full from 50, both full at 50. 100 = only the chopped sound, 0 = only the original. The gaps between notes are silent in the wet sound.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
